name: FAITHQA
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate intent hallucination in LLM generation, containing 18,068 problems that cover query-only and retrieval-augmented generation setups, assessing minor and major fabrication errors in responses.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for intent hallucination that is useful for factuality and fabrication analysis, but it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on detecting intent hallucination in LLM outputs, distinguishing between minor and major fabrications, and includes an automatic evaluation method called INTENT DECOMPOSE.
